summary: Introduces the task debugger, which lets you inspect and set variables, change module arguments and re-run a failed task during execution, then continue the playbook.
questions: Can I fix a failing task without rerunning the whole playbook?
What does the Ansible task debugger do?

answer_card.title: What the task debugger does
answer_card.answer_md: The task debugger lets you fix errors **during execution**: inspect or set variables, update module arguments, re-run the task, and continue the playbook, instead of editing and re-running everything.
